Welcome to the course.

This file demonstrates the conventions:

- it lives in `01_Introduction/`, so it becomes an item in the **Introduction** module;
- its `01_` prefix sets its position and is stripped from the Canvas title;
- `canvas.type: page` makes it a Canvas Page;
- it starts unpublished, so it won't be visible to students until you set
  `published: true`.

Delete this file once you have real content.
